key_point: A real island thanked these game developers
title: A real island thanked these game developers
caption: Ghost of Tsushima's directors were named permanent tourism ambassadors of the real Tsushima island. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #ghostoftsushima #suckerpunch

instagram.caption:
Ghost of Tsushima is set on a real island between Japan and Korea, during the Mongol invasion of 1274.

In 2021, Tsushima city named directors Nate Fox and Jason Connell permanent tourism ambassadors for spreading its history around the world.

It was the first time the honor went to people for a creative work. The mayor invited the whole studio to visit.

Would you visit Tsushima after playing?
